articles.title: Hugging Face Diffusers Flaws Could Let Model Repositories Execute Arbitrary Code
articles.summary: Three high-severity security flaws have been disclosed in Hugging Face's Diffusers library that could allow crafted model repositories to stealthily execute arbitrary code on machines that load it, opening the artificial intelligence (AI) supply chain to security risk. articles.title: Chinese military researchers tap US AI models to train defense systems
articles.summary: Chinese researchers have reportedly used leading U.S. AI models developed by OpenAI and Anthropic to train AI systems to advance defense capabilities.
